entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had recently signed the Emergency..."
entries.dialogueText: I had recently signed the Emergency Act, which created a ruckus in the Sordish Police Forces and the Grand National Assembly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Now it was time to make a speech in..."
entries.dialogueText: Now it was time to make a speech in the Assembly and declare the emergency in public.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked with quick steps in the co..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked with quick steps in the corridors of the Grand National Assembly, giving my greetings to the people I encountered on my way towards the parliamentary hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When I entered the hall, the Assemb..."
entries.dialogueText: When I entered the hall, the Assembly was in complete chaos, with shouting and cursing between the parties. There was a heavy argument about a proposal made by an MP from NFP.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took my seat inside the special a..."
entries.dialogueText: I took my seat inside the special area reserved for the ministers. Gloria was shouting from her seat at the center of the hall as she hit the gavel three times, with each strike heavier than the one before.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "<shout>"ORDER! ORDER!"</shout>"
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"ORDER! ORDER!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Despite her efforts, the argument c..."
entries.dialogueText: Despite her efforts, the argument continued for a couple of minutes before everybody took back to their seats and finally went quiet.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Mr. Kibener, next time when I tell..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Kibener, next time when I tell you to do so, either take your seat or leave the hall; so we can proceed with the procedures of this Assembly and continue our duties."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some MP's from the NFP side shouted..."
entries.dialogueText: Some MP's from the NFP side shouted back at her in protest.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Honorable ladies and gentlemen, if..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honorable ladies and gentlemen, if you allow me to continue..."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""We have the President here with us..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have the President here with us today. He has an important declaration to make."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw Kesaro Kibener standing up fr..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw Kesaro Kibener standing up from his seat and shouting towards the members of the PFJP.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Mr. Kibener! Calm yourself! Show r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Kibener! Calm yourself! Show respect to the procedures of this Assembly!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She pointed at me with her hand."
entries.dialogueText: She pointed at me with her hand.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""The President has the floor.""
entries.dialogueText: "The President has the floor."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Assembly fell silent."
entries.dialogueText: The Assembly fell silent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked to the stand as loud clapp..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked to the stand as loud clapping started in the USP's side.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Ladies and Gentlemen of the Grand..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and Gentlemen of the Grand National Assembly of Sordland! I am here today to present an important decision of the State concerning the recent troubling developments in Sordland."
entries.menuText: "Ladies and Gentlemen..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sordland has gone through a critic..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland has gone through a critical day on January when Bernard Circas was shot by a militant member of the Young Sords. That day marked the beginning of terror against Sordland and its citizens."
entries.menuText: Focus on the shooting of Bernard Circas.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sordland is going through critical..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland is going through critical times! The clashes between extremist political organizations have taken their fights to the streets and started threatening the national security of our country."
entries.menuText: Focus on the clashes between the Red Youth and Young Sords.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sordland has long been plagued by..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland has long been plagued by Bludish separatist groups inside our borders. Their threat, however, has never been greater. They have been heavily arming themselves with military aid from Rumburg against Sordland!"
entries.menuText: Focus on the Bludish Freedom Front and Rumburg's aid.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I brought attention to..."
entries.dialogueText: I brought attention to...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I brought attention to..."
entries.dialogueText: I brought attention to...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I brought attention to..."
entries.dialogueText: I brought attention to...

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Young Sords and their actions agai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Young Sords and their actions against the public and the State can no longer be tolerated. Thus, the Sordish ultranationalist movement must be regarded as a national security threat from today onwards."
entries.menuText: The threat of the Young Sords and the right wing agenda.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sordland is clearly experiencing a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland is clearly experiencing a dangerous civil strife between left and right wing extremist groups, which put our citizens lives in danger and act against our State in hopes of toppling our government. Today we find ourselves in a time of emergency."
entries.menuText: The threat of extreme left and right wing groups in Sordland.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Red Youth and their actions agains..."
entries.dialogueText: "Red Youth and their actions against the public and the State can no longer be tolerated. Thus, the Sordish communist movement must be regarded as a national security threat from today onwards."
entries.menuText: The threat of the Red Youth and the left wing agenda.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All Bludish separatist groups and..."
entries.dialogueText: "All Bludish separatist groups and the supporters of Bludish Freedom Front must be regarded as national security threats from today onwards. Sordland can no longer harbour these paramilitary organizations who plans to attack our sovereign nation."
entries.menuText: The threat of the Bludish separatists.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""With the armament of the BFF, Rumb..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the armament of the BFF, Rumburg has shown a clear aggressive stance against Sordland. They pose a major national security threat for our country. We must stay strong and be ready against their treacherous actions."
entries.menuText: The threat of Rumburg.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Applauses came from the NFP seats."
entries.dialogueText: Applauses came from the NFP seats.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Applauses came from the NFP seats."
entries.dialogueText: Applauses came from the NFP seats.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The opposition members started yell..."
entries.dialogueText: The opposition members started yelling in protest.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "NFP members started yelling in prot..."
entries.dialogueText: NFP members started yelling in protest.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""On top of that, we have found that..."
entries.dialogueText: "On top of that, we have found that the Bludish separatists are planning to occupy the region of Bergia and form a new nation inside our borders. Therefore, the State has decided to take extraordinary measures to handle these threats swiftly."
entries.menuText: Blame the Bludish separatists for a plan to occupy Bergia.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""On top of that, we have found that..."
entries.dialogueText: "On top of that, we have found that the communists are planning to stage a communist revolution in Sordland by toppling our government. Therefore, the State has decided to take extraordinary measures to handle these threats swiftly."
entries.menuText: Blame the communists for a plan to overthrow the government.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""On top of that, we have found that..."
entries.dialogueText: "On top of that, we have found that the ultranationalists are planning to overthrow our government and bring a totalist maximist state. Therefore, the State has decided to take extraordinary measures to handle these threats swiftly."
entries.menuText: Blame the ultranationalists for a plan to overthrow the government.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The foreign powers are to be blame..."
entries.dialogueText: "The foreign powers are to be blamed! They are disrespecting the sovereignty of our nation and agitate and support these extremist groups against our country in hopes of toppling our government to establish a puppet state. The State will now react swiftly to these threats."
entries.menuText: Blame foreign powers for supporting extremist groups.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The police will be given increased..."
entries.dialogueText: "The police will be given increased authority in regard to their use of force. Searching civilians and orders for confiscations will be permissible beyond their legal limits for the duration of the Emergency period."
entries.menuText: "The police will be given increased authority..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Surveillance capabilities of the S..."
entries.dialogueText: "Surveillance capabilities of the State will be increased beyond their limits until further notice."
entries.menuText: "Surveillance capabilities of the State will be increased..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Suspects will not require a trial..."
entries.dialogueText: "Suspects will not require a trial to be detained if said crime endangers the State and the wellbeing of its citizens."
entries.menuText: "Suspects will not require a trial to be detained..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The right to assemble in protest w..."
entries.dialogueText: "The right to assemble in protest will be suspended for the duration of the Emergency. All citizens are expected to abide by the law and the police is given permission to use force against assembled crowds."
entries.menuText: "The right to assemble in protest will be suspended..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""In accordance with Article 57 and..."
entries.dialogueText: "In accordance with Article 57 and 58 of the Constitution, the State holds the right to order for these measures to be taken in a situation of emergency like we have today."
entries.menuText: "In accordance with Article 57..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a loud reaction from the..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a loud reaction from the Assembly.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""The President has not finished!""
entries.dialogueText: "The President has not finished!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gloria hit the gavel again."
entries.dialogueText: Gloria hit the gavel again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun Leke, a Bludish MP, who was..."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun Leke, a Bludish MP, who was regarded as the leader of the independents, jumped from his seat and started shouting at me.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "<shout>"THIS IS TOTALISM!"</shout>"
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"THIS IS TOTALISM!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""These measures, although extraordi..."
entries.dialogueText: "These measures, although extraordinary, were completely necessary for us to take. We must be vigilant as a nation in times of crisis and surely we will be triumphant."
entries.menuText: Continue with the speech.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I found a time to take a breather d..."
entries.dialogueText: I found a time to take a breather during the loud commotion.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Can you please be quiet when I'm s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can you please be quiet when I'm speaking, Mr. Leke?"
entries.menuText: "Can you please be quiet when I'm speaking, Mr. Leke?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I continued among applauses from th..."
entries.dialogueText: I continued among applauses from the USP seats.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Ladies and gentlemen of the Assemb..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Assembly! We must set aside our differences."
entries.menuText: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Assembly! We must set aside our differences."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""We will be resuming with our forei..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will be resuming with our foreign policy as usual during this period of Emergency."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""In accordance with the Emergency A..."
entries.dialogueText: "In accordance with the Emergency Act, Sordland will sever all diplomatic ties with Rumburg for their treacherous actions. We will be responding with an embargo."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""In accordance with the Emergency A..."
entries.dialogueText: "In accordance with the Emergency Act, Sordland will sever all diplomatic ties with United Contana for their treacherous actions. We will be responding with an embargo."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Same measures will also be taken a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Same measures will also be taken against United Contana..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""In accordance with the Emergency A..."
entries.dialogueText: "In accordance with the Emergency Act, Sordland will sever all diplomatic ties with Arcasia for their actions of treason against Sordland. We will be responding with an embargo."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Same measures will also be taken a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Same measures will also be taken against Arcasia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Sordland will stand alone if needs..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland will stand alone if needs be. Whatever the case may be, we must be strong."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""...And Arcasia.""
entries.dialogueText: "...And Arcasia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""We must be strong as a nation and..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must be strong as a nation and preserve our connections."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I paused and took a look at the Ass..."
entries.dialogueText: I paused and took a look at the Assembly.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Today, we must fight for Sordland!""
entries.dialogueText: "Today, we must fight for Sordland!"
entries.menuText: "Today, we must fight for Sordland!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I ask everyone to understand our s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I ask everyone to understand our situation."
entries.menuText: "I ask everyone to understand our situation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must finally be brave and strik..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must finally be brave and strike down the red threat!"
entries.menuText: "We must finally be brave and strike down the red threat!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "USP seats applauded."
entries.dialogueText: USP seats applauded.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I ask everybody to be patient.""
entries.dialogueText: "I ask everybody to be patient."
entries.menuText: "I ask everybody to be patient."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will fight against the maximist..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will fight against the maximists together!"
entries.menuText: "We will fight against the maximists together!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I assure you that this period will..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assure you that this period will not last long."
entries.menuText: "I assure you that this period will not last long."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will eliminate all who oppose t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will eliminate all who oppose the State!"
entries.menuText: "We will eliminate all who oppose the State!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We ask for everybody's cooperation..."
entries.dialogueText: "We ask for everybody's cooperation and support."
entries.menuText: "We ask for everybody's cooperation and support."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The State will swiftly address the..."
entries.dialogueText: "The State will swiftly address the situation."
entries.menuText: "The State will swiftly address the situation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Bludish Issue will finally be..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Bludish Issue will finally be addressed!"
entries.menuText: "The Bludish Issue will finally be addressed!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Blud separatists will soon be erad..."
entries.dialogueText: "Blud separatists will soon be eradicated!"
entries.menuText: "Blud separatists will soon be eradicated!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saluted the crowd."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted the crowd.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For a free Sordland!""
entries.dialogueText: "For a free Sordland!"
entries.menuText: "For a free Sordland!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For a strong Sordland!""
entries.dialogueText: "For a strong Sordland!"
entries.menuText: "For a strong Sordland!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For peace in Sordland!""
entries.dialogueText: "For peace in Sordland!"
entries.menuText: "For peace in Sordland!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For the legacy of Soll!""
entries.dialogueText: "For the legacy of Soll!"
entries.menuText: "For the legacy of Soll!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Assembly roared with all kinds..."
entries.dialogueText: The Assembly roared with all kinds of different reactions.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "While most of the USP members appla..."
entries.dialogueText: While most of the USP members applauded, all of the opposition yelled in protest as I left the stand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sounds of protest gradually inc..."
entries.dialogueText: The sounds of protest gradually increased as I walked towards my seat.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Thank you for the announcement, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the announcement, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun Leke started yelling at me..."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun Leke started yelling at me again.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "<shout>"YOU ARE JUST LIKE SOLL!"</s..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"YOU ARE JUST LIKE SOLL!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "<shout>"LEAVE BLUDISH PEOPLE ALONE!..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"LEAVE BLUDISH PEOPLE ALONE!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Kesaro stood up from his seat and w..."
entries.dialogueText: Kesaro stood up from his seat and walked closer to me and yelled at me.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: "<shout>"This is a mistake, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"This is a mistake, Mr. President! How dare you target the nationalists?"</shout>

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: "<shout>"Young Sords are a group of..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"Young Sords are a group of people who love their country and Sordish culture! They are not the enemies!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Kesaro stood up from his seat and y..."
entries.dialogueText: Kesaro stood up from his seat and yelled back at Mansoun.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: "<shout>"YOU LIVE IN SORDLAND, MR. L..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"YOU LIVE IN SORDLAND, MR. LEKE!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: "<shout>"YOU CANNOT FIGHT AGAINST TH..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"YOU CANNOT FIGHT AGAINST THIS COUNTRY AND EXPECT IT NOT TO REACT!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun Leke started yelling at me..."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun Leke started yelling at me again.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "<shout>"Wasn't it enough that the u..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"Wasn't it enough that the ultranationalists murdered Bernard Circas in cold blood!?"</shout>

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "<shout>"Now you are declaring a war..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"Now you are declaring a war against the left! You are just like Soll, Mr. President!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "<shout>"A cold blooded nationalist!..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"A cold blooded nationalist!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gloria started hitting the gavel ag..."
entries.dialogueText: Gloria started hitting the gavel again when the situation escalated further.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Kesaro stood up from his seat and y..."
entries.dialogueText: Kesaro stood up from his seat and yelled back at Mansoun.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: "<shout>"HOW DARE YOU TALK LIKE THAT..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"HOW DARE YOU TALK LIKE THAT IN HERE?"</shout>

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: "<shout>"YOU LIVE IN SORDLAND, MR. L..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"YOU LIVE IN SORDLAND, MR. LEKE!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "<shout>"ORDER!"</shout>"
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"ORDER!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Gentlemen, when will you learn to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gentlemen, when will you learn to behave like adults?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once I was sure the Assembly's atte..."
entries.dialogueText: Once I was sure the Assembly's attention was on Gloria, I left the hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked back to the Palace in sile..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked back to the Palace in silence.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Honorable Members of the Grand Nat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honorable Members of the Grand National Assembly of Sordland! I am here today to present an important decision of the State concerning the recent troubling developments in Sordland."
entries.menuText: "Honorable Members of Assembly..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Brothers and sisters! I am here to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Brothers and sisters! I am here today to present an important decision of the State concerning the recent troubling developments in Sordland."
entries.menuText: "Brothers and sisters..."
